::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

The calculus notes are split across these pages:

- [Derivatives and Taylor Series](calculus-derivatives.qmd):
  limits and derivatives, derivative rules, tangent lines, linear approximation,
  critical points and optimization, and Taylor series.
- [Integrals and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus](calculus-integration.qmd):
  antiderivatives, regularity conditions,
  and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.
- [Double Integrals and Fubini's Theorem](calculus-double-integrals.qmd):
  double integrals over rectangles and non-rectangular regions,
  and Fubini's and Tonelli's theorems.

A link to a section, theorem or definition on this page from before the split
goes on to the page that now holds it.

:::
